subject.title: perf(ui): drop zod from the Control UI and lazy-load json5 with the config surfaces

question: Should this maintainer-labeled performance change be accepted after a maintainer reviews the lazy JSON5 upgrade path for existing commented configurations and redacted autosave behavior?
rationale: The implementation changes an existing configuration parser from synchronous startup availability to an asynchronous on-demand dependency; the supplied branch rationale describes the edge cases, but human acceptance should confirm the intended compatibility boundary.

options.title: Request focused live proof
options.body: Ask for redacted evidence of a cold config-page load, JSON5 comment edit, save, and navigation/unload path before merge.

options.title: Accept the documented tradeoff
options.body: Merge after maintainer review if the stated retry and gateway redaction contracts are accepted as sufficient compatibility protection.

recommendation.title: Request focused live proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted evidence of a cold config-page load, JSON5 comment edit, save, and navigation/unload path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent merged-history connection to the Control UI startup optimization sequence and the changed configuration path.
